plan.title: Household Survey Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Coverage by village and enumerator, submissions over time

panels.title: Total submissions
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM household_survey

panels.title: Submissions by enumerator
panels.sql: SELECT enumerator_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Submissions by village
panels.sql: SELECT village, COUNT(*) AS n FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly submissions
panels.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 villages by submissions
panels.sql: SELECT village, COUNT(*) AS n FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows the coverage of the household survey by village and enumerator, as well as the submissions over time. The top 10 villages by submissions are also shown. The total number of submissions is {{p1}}.
